children.value: > Fact From Story: On Monday, a federal jury surprised the world by siding with Fortnite maker Epic Games in its fight to break Google’s control over Android apps
> > Fact From Story: Sweeney is Epic’s CEO, co-founder, and importantly its controlling shareholder.
> > > > Fact From Story: It’s been his fight from the very beginning, and he watched almost the entire trial in person from the best seat in the house | Fact From Story
> > > > Commonsense Knowledge: People generally watch events that are important to them. | Commonsense Knowledge

> > Fact From Story: the nine-person jury decided that Google has an illegal monopoly over Android app distribution and in-app payment systems, and that Google illegally tied its Google Play billing system to its app store.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A CEO of a company would be happy if their company won a court case.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A jury siding with a company in a fight against another company means that the first company won the court case .
